system.notes:
A defiled mummy lord whose head was decapitated and replaced with a beast's head. Filled with rage and ire.

AC 14, HP 35, ATK 3 slam +5 (1d8), MV near, S +4, D +3, C +4, I -3, W +3, Ch +4, AL C, LV 7

Berserk. When at or below 20 HP, +1 slam attack and slams deal double damage.

Bestial Curse. When reduced to 0 HP, utters curse. All foes within near, WIS 15+ or 1d6 WIS and 1d6 CHA damage (can't heal while ill). Repeat check once per day; ends on success. Transform into beast at 0 WIS or CHA.

Desiccated. Can be damaged by fire. Takes x2 damage from it.

Supreme Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by magical sources.
